name: Dominic Brown
bio:
Dominic Brown, a highly skilled tattoo artist based in Manchester, UK, specializes in the intricate black & gray and realism styles. With around 110,000 followers on Instagram, his captivating work has found a vast audience appreciating his meticulous attention to detail. Whether you're a tattoo enthusiast or a first-timer, you can expect superior workmanship from Dominic. His choice of premium tools, including those from Inkjecta, Kwadron, and Butterluxe underscore his commitment towards the craft.
